CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.norm_room_search_text(t text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select trim(
    regexp_replace(
      regexp_replace(
        regexp_replace(
          regexp_replace(
            lower(coalesce(t, '')),
            '[,.;:]+',
            ' ',
            'g'
          ),
          '\m(phường|phuong|p)\M',
          ' ',
          'g'
        ),
        '\m(quận|quan|q)\M',
        ' ',
        'g'
      ),
      '\s+',
      ' ',
      'g'
    )
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.public_house_number_v1(p_value text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case
    when nullif(btrim(p_value), '') is null then '...'
    when strpos(p_value, '/') > 0 then
      case
        when nullif(btrim(split_part(p_value, '/', 1)), '') is null then '..'
        else btrim(split_part(p_value, '/', 1)) || '/..'
      end
    when btrim(p_value) ~ '^[0-9]+$' then '..'
    when substring(btrim(p_value) from '^([0-9]+)') is not null then
      substring(btrim(p_value) from '^([0-9]+)') || '...'
    else '...'
  end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.room_content_search_document(p_house text, p_description text, p_amenities text, p_include_house boolean)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case when p_include_house then public.norm_room_search_text(concat_ws(' ',p_description,p_amenities))
    else coalesce((select string_agg(token,' ' order by ordinal)
      from regexp_split_to_table(public.norm_room_search_text(concat_ws(' ',p_description,p_amenities)),'\s+') with ordinality as words(token,ordinal)
      where public.norm_room_search_text(p_house)='' or
        regexp_replace(token,'^[^[:alnum:]]+|[^[:alnum:]]+$','','g')<>public.norm_room_search_text(p_house)), '') end;
$function$

SELECT r.id,
    r.property_id,
    p.code AS property_code,
    p.name AS property_name,
    r.room_type,
    r.room_code,
    r.address,
    r.house_number,
    r.ward,
    r.district,
    r.price,
    r.status,
    r.description,
    r.created_at,
    r.updated_at,
    r.gallery_urls,
    COALESCE(rd.has_elevator, false) AS has_elevator,
    COALESCE(rd.has_stairs, false) AS has_stairs,
    COALESCE(rd.allow_pet, false) AS allow_pet,
    COALESCE(rd.allow_cat, false) AS allow_cat,
    COALESCE(rd.allow_dog, false) AS allow_dog,
    COALESCE(rd.no_pet, false) AS no_pet,
    COALESCE(rd.short_term, false) AS short_term,
    COALESCE(rd.long_term, true) AS long_term
   FROM rooms r
     JOIN properties p ON p.id = r.property_id
     LEFT JOIN room_details rd ON rd.room_id = r.id
  WHERE r.lifecycle_status = 'active'::text AND r.publish_status = 'published'::text AND COALESCE(r.is_hidden, false) = false AND p.approval_status = 'approved'::text AND p.lifecycle_status = 'active'::text;
